sources.entry: Otter Wiki - Simple, easy to use wiki software using markdown. (Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Otter Wiki is a Python/Flask wiki that stores its pages in a git repository and uses Markdown for markup.
summary.what_it_does: Otter Wiki is a collaborative wiki written in Python with the Flask microframework. Page content is kept in a git repository, which tracks every change. Pages are written in Markdown, with an editor that has Markdown highlighting and table support (CodeMirror). The README lists extended Markdown for tables, footnotes, fancy blocks, alerts and mermaid diagrams. It also provides a changelog and page history, user authentication, page attachments, and a sidebar that can show a menu and/or page index. The interface includes a dark mode. An experimental git HTTP server lets you clone, pull and push wiki content.
how_to_run: Copy and edit the docker-compose.yml below to match your preferences.
Access the wiki via the configured port (8080 maps to the container's port 80) if run on your machine.
Register your account. The first account is an admin account with access to the settings tab.
Customize the settings to your liking.
notable: Content is stored in a git repository that tracks all changes
Extended Markdown with tables, footnotes, alerts and mermaid diagrams
Experimental git HTTP server to clone, pull and push wiki content
Customizable sidebar with menu and/or page index
caveats: The git HTTP server feature is marked experimental in the README
Recommended installation is via docker-compose; the README points to a separate installation guide for web server setup (nginx, apache, caddy) for internet access
